text: In the lab, the ESN's open-loop (1-step-ahead) NMSE on Mackey-Glass is very small — the network essentially learns a smooth interpolation of the signal.
explanation: True: the lab notes the 1-step open-loop NMSE should be very small because Mackey-Glass is smooth, so one-step prediction is easy. The difficulty appears only in multi-step closed-loop generation.
